title: GHSL AI agent helps find untrusted checkout execution in faststream
summary: The pr_autoupdate.yaml pull_request_target workflow checked out attacker-controlled pull request code and then ran pip installation, exposing a privileged automerge token and write permissions.
ai_role: GHSL explicitly credits its AI agent and CodeQL jointly; their contributions are not separated. Reported 2025-08-06 and fixed 2025-08-07. No CVE is listed.
classification_note: The advisory describes a vulnerability and potential impact; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL records that faststream fixed the issue on 2025-08-07. No CVE is listed.

impacts.conditions: Untrusted checkout is executed in faststream workflow context; GHSL advisory identifies untrusted-checkout execution.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not establish exploitation in the wild.
